capabilities: Encrypt selected text, files with attachments, folders or the whole vault
Hook the vault adapter to decrypt on read and encrypt on write
Lock and unlock with idle and background timers
Run resumable batch encryption with a journal
Change password or re-key with a new master key
disambiguation: Not a password manager or vault-sync tool; it encrypts and decrypts files in place through Obsidian's file adapter and stores no password.
extras: Passwords are never stored; a forgotten password or lost key file means the data cannot be recovered. The README says to turn off the core File recovery plugin, which otherwise keeps plaintext snapshots. PDF, audio and video attachments are unverified, and Windows and Linux desktop are untested. Hiding file names is experimental and off by default.
problem: Notes, attachments and backups on disk, in cloud storage or in synced copies are readable as plain text to anyone who obtains them.
summary: Encryption plugin that keeps selected text, files with attachments, folders or the whole vault as ciphertext on disk, decrypting in memory while unlocked.
